Volunteer/Unpaid (as per rules)

Meal provided

Location: Downtown Toronto 

**Sound Operator **

Shoot day: Saturday, October 17

Tentative shoot time: 9:00 AM–10:00 PM

**HMUA**

Shoot day: Saturday, October 17

**Editor: **Editing will take place between October 17–18, with availability throughout the weekend needed to meet the submission deadline.

This is an opportunity to collaborate with fellow creatives and bring an original short film to life in just 48 hours.

Interested? Please send me an email to [thestarplayersto@gmail.com](mailto:thestarplayersto@gmail.com) with a little about your experience and any relevant portfolio or work samples.

Feel free to share with anyone who might be interested!

Let’s make something great!

**🎬 CASTING CALL **🎥

**FEATURE FILM CAST DESCRIPTION**

**TERROR IN TIMMONTON**

**An Independent Mystery / Suspense Feature Film**

**Production Company:** R&R Visionary Productions
**Genre:** Mystery / Suspense
**Production Type:** Independent Feature Film
**Union Status:** Non-Union
**Filming Location:** Waterloo / Cedar Falls, Iowa
**Filming Begins:** Summer 2027
**Projected Release:** 2028
**Casting Deadline:** October 31, 2026

**About the Film**

*She survived the nightmare. But what if leaving it behind only led her into another?*

After enduring more than eight years of abuse, Hailee finally escapes her troubled past, only to become the victim of a brutal attack that nearly takes her life.

While recovering in the hospital, she develops an unexpected friendship with a male nurse who offers her the opportunity to leave Arizona and begin a new life.

But her fresh start takes a mysterious turn when she discovers a hidden note behind a bedroom nightstand.

**"If you are reading this, that means I am dead. — Annalise."**

Determined to uncover the truth, Hailee begins asking questions about Annalise. However, the people around her claim to know nothing about the mysterious woman.

As secrets begin to surface, Hailee realizes that her new home may hold a disturbing past—and that some people will do anything to keep the truth buried.

**Compensation and Meals**

This is an **unpaid, volunteer-based independent feature film production**. There is no monetary compensation for acting roles.

Participants will have the opportunity to gain valuable on-set experience, develop their acting skills, build their portfolios, and participate in a full-length feature film.

**Lunch and supper will be provided at no cost to cast members on their scheduled filming days.**

**How to Apply**

Interested actors may submit through **Backstage** or email:

**[rrvisionaryproductions@gmail.com](mailto:rrvisionaryproductions@gmail.com)**

Please include:
* Your full name and contact information
* The character or role you wish to audition for
* A recent headshot or photograph
* Acting résumé or previous experience, if available
* Your anticipated availability during Summer 2027

**CASTING DEADLINE: OCTOBER 31, 2026**

**JOIN THE CAST!**

R&R Visionary Productions welcomes dedicated, enthusiastic individuals who are passionate about storytelling and independent filmmaking.

Help us bring the secrets, mystery, and suspense of *Terror in *

*Timmonton* to the big screen!

**R&R Visionary Productions**
*Bringing Stories to Life*

Cześć! Szukam dwóch epizodystów mężczyzn azjatyckiego pochodzenia, najlepiej chińskiego, do jednej sceny w krótkim metrażu realizowanym w ramach Warszawskiej Szkoły Filmowej.

Poszukiwani aktorzy:

* Aktor 1: około 30 lat
* Aktor 2: około 50 lat

📅 Terminy zdjęć: 25 i 26 października 2026 r. (Autor 30 lat tylko jeden dzień zdjęciowy ).

⏱️ Czas pracy: do 6 godzin.

💰 Wynagrodzenie: zdjęcia są płatne.

Jeśli jesteś zainteresowany, proszę o wiadomość prywatną z następującymi informacjami:

* aktualne zdjęcie (najlepiej portretowe i sylwetkowe),
* wiek,
* wzrost,
* doświadczenie aktorskie (jeśli posiadasz),
* dostępność w podanych terminach.

Będę wdzięczna za zgłoszenia oraz udostępnienia! 😊

Do zobaczenia na planie! 🎥

items.text: Je suis diplômé du GITIS à Moscou, recherche un comédien pour une pièce sur Amadeo Modigliani âgé de 23 à 33 ans pour des représentations au Théâtre au centre de Paris. Les répétitions sont en coursselon le système Stanislavski. Une pièce moderne avec quatre personnages. La durée de la représentation est de 50 min. Ce travail est en tant que bénévole, mais nous espérons obtenir un contrat et de l'argent. Répétitions au théâtre le dimanche et 1 à 2 fois en semaine sur rendez-vous à un horaire convenant.

🎭✨ NEW FOR JANUARY 2027 – ADULT MUSICAL THEATRE! ✨🎭

🌟 The Ensemble Productions is excited to announce our BRAND NEW Adult Musical Theatre Class, launching in January 2027! 🌟

Have you always wanted to give musical theatre a go? Maybe you’ve performed before and want to get back into it? Or perhaps you’re simply looking for a new hobby and a chance to meet like-minded people!

Whatever your experience, this class is for YOU! 💖

Led by Musical Theatre Performer Ava Fletcher, our weekly sessions will explore the wonderful world of musical theatre through singing, dancing and acting, bringing some of your favourite musicals to life!

Whether you’re a complete beginner or an experienced performer, our classes offer a welcoming, supportive and fun environment where everyone can get involved.

🎭 CLASS DETAILS 🎭

📅 Every Tuesday – Starting January 2027

⏰ 6:30pm – 7:30pm

📍 Hampton Garden School – Dance Studio, Hampton, Peterborough

✨ Open to adults of all abilities and experience levels!

💖 At The Ensemble, we believe everyone deserves the chance to fly, and we can’t wait to welcome some new faces into our growing performing arts community!

📩 INTERESTED IN JOINING?

We’re now taking expressions of interest for January!

Spaces will be limited, so get in touch to register your interest and secure priority booking.

📧 info.ensembleproductions@gmail.com

Poszukujemy Statystów w wieku 18-70 lat (kobiety i mężczyzn) z Kielc lub okolic na plan zdjęciowy do spotu reklamowego dla znanej sieci restauracji w Kielcach w dniach 3.11, lub 4.11 (wtorek lub środa).

1. Zdjęcia w plenerze. Nagrania późnym popołudniem do nocy.

2. Wynagrodzenie za 1 dzień zdjęciowy: 150 zł netto (płatne w ciągu 1 dnia po planie zdjęciowym — BLIK na numer telefonu/konto bankowe).

W razie zainteresowania i dostępności w dniach 3.11 lub 4.11 prosimy o wysłanie zgłoszenia, podając następujące informację:

1. Imię i nazwisko

2. Rok urodzenia

3. Miasto zamieszkania

4. Telefon kontaktowy

5. Adres e-mail

6. Wzrost

7. Czy jest Pan/Pani dostępna/y w terminie 3.11-4.11?

8. Link do swojego profilu na Facebook/Instagram

9. Minimum jedno zdjęcie

Kontakt: rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl

W temacie wiadomości prosimy napisać: Plan zdjęciowy Kielce

Wysłanie zgłoszenie jest jednoznaczne z wyrażeniem zgody na przetwarzanie danych osobowych w celu udziału w planie zdjęciowym zgodnie z Rozporządzeniem Parlamentu Europejskiego i Rady (UE) 2016/679 z dnia 27 kwietnia 2016 r. w sprawie ochrony osób fizycznych w związku z przetwarzaniem danych osobowych i w sprawie swobodnego przepływu takich danych oraz uchylenia dyrektywy 95/46/WE (ogólne rozporządzenie o ochronie danych). Administratorem Twoich danych osobowych pozyskanych w procesie rekrutacyjnym jest Agencja Artystyczna INFERNAL. Podanie danych jest dobrowolne, w każdej chwili przysługuje Ci prawo do wglądu do danych, ich poprawiania lub usunięcia. Kontakt do administratora rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl.

FINAL CALL - Casting now!

We're looking for energetic, charismatic and outgoing personalities to join us for an exciting corporate celebration for one of social media's favourite skincare brands! 

Think big personalities, playful humour, interactive entertainment and an incredible party atmosphere!

 Location: Engine Works, Glasgow

 Date: Friday 23 October 2026

 Glasgow & Scotland-based talent preferred! (We are paying mileage so let us know)

 PAID WEEKLY

 Travel expenses covered as agreed

AVAILABLE ROLES

 BRAND AMBASSADORS x1

 £15 per hour + travel/fuel expense

 2 PM – Midnight

Confident, friendly and energetic individuals who love interacting with people! Previous promotional or event experience preferred.

 EVENT MANAGER x1

 £17.50 per hour + travel fuel expense

 2 PM – Midnight

Experienced event professional with excellent leadership, organisational and guest management skills. Someone proactive who can lead the team and keep everything running smoothly!

 HOSTS / COMPÈRES x1

 Rate TBC – dependent on experience

 Approx. 2 PM – 7 PM

 BIG PERSONALITIES WANTED!

We're looking for fun, confident and engaging entertainers to host interactive games stations as part of a lively team tournament.

You'll need to hype up crowds, encourage participation, think on your feet and create an amazing atmosphere!

Previous hosting, presenting or entertainment experience essential.

 COMEDY ACTOR / IMPROV PERFORMER x1

 Rate TBC – dependent on experience

 Approx. 2 PM – 7 PM

 ARE YOU NATURALLY HILARIOUS?

We're looking for a quick-witted, charismatic performer with brilliant improvisation skills and a great sense of humour!

You'll be entertaining guests through spontaneous interactions, witty one-liners and playful comedy.

Stand-up comedy or interactive theatre experience highly desirable!

To apply, please email:  recruit@weareplay.co.uk

•⁠  ⁠Current location

Thanks!

Jigsaw Casting is seeking Canadian User -generated videos that show a ‘winning moment’ in life for a LOTTO 649 campaign done through TBWA\Canada (address: 219 Dufferin Street, Suite 302C, Toronto, ON, M6K 3J1/Tel: 416.483.3600/[https://tbwa.ca/](https://tbwa.ca/?fbclid=IwZXh0bgNhZW0CMTAAcGRvZgFicmlkETFaZzlmNFdiS1JOMTRibVNkc3J0YwZhcHBfaWQQMjIyMDM5MTc4ODIwMDg5MgABHifDGia4LsOANDG_Ih2ltQT9AaeTz2u2uhuNe4hNlIgkWLvv1Kcxh0Qp2M2Z_aem_X_R1CiZkB1duyws1Eg9Ziw)) (Excludes submissions from the province of Quebec)

We are looking for those moments that feel like someone is coming out on top. Your video clips should have a range of emotions. Some are fist pumping celebrations (i.e. catching a baseball). Others are beautiful, heartfelt moments (i.e. someone asking out his crush and getting her number, or someone getting married and it was a very emotional romantic moment).

We’ll prioritize a broad range of Canadian experiences and affinities, from fishing and outdoor activities to sports, city moments, friendships, family and romantic relationships.

Canadian-shot content only: All footage must be filmed in Canada. Canadian creators are preferred, and recognizable non-Canadian locations/backdrops should be avoided. Generic footage from a Canadian creator that does not reveal an identifiable foreign location may be considered subject to client approval.

What we are looking for:

Our clips also fall into two camps: The Win and The Agency.

The Win
This shows the moment people come out on top.
For example:
→ Pulling a giant trout from the water
→ Catching a home run baseball in the stands

The Agency
This shows a moment of doubt, hesitation, or choice.
→ A moment before their hole-in-one swing, a friend saying they can’t make the shot.
→ Someone getting egged on before they go on stage and slay at karaoke.
→ Someone is deliberating doing that cliff dive. Do they vs don’t they.

If you have another footage that is a wild card, it may not fit the above specs, you can still submit it.

The selected videos would be used for our LOTTO 649 campaign. This is a non-union project. If your video is chosen, you will be paid $2,500.00 per video.

Permissions:
Submitted videos must have been shot prior to October 14, 2026.
The person who has filmed the video has granted permission for the video to appear in the ad on TV and online.
All talent who appears in the video are cleared and grant permission for the video to be used

Here’s a top line of things to avoid:
No one under 25 and no children of any age in the video clips.
Nothing that could be perceived as appealing to children. This is a bit nebulous, we know, so use your best judgement.
Nothing that comes across as specifically American.
No alcohol is shown in the clip.

Submissions are due ASAP or before: October 28 at 11am EST.

If interested, you must upload your video(s)to be considered to:
https://lotto649ugc.castingcrane.com/

🎬 **CASTING CALL – A MISTAKE (Short Film)**

Hi everyone! We're looking for two actors for our upcoming **7-minute short film**, *A Mistake*, shooting in Central Burnaby on **October 29**.

**LOGLINE**
Two friends bond over the struggles of dating and being single while on a hike, but things take an awkward turn when one jokingly suggests they start dating each other and the other doesn't take it well.

**ROLES**

**BEN | Late 20s | Open ethnicity**
A bit awkward, literal, and straightforward, with a dry sense of humour. Ben and Sarah were friends in high school but drifted apart after graduation. He's been single for a while and figures he has nothing to lose by jokingly suggesting they start dating, but the conversation takes an unexpected turn.

**SARAH | Late 20s | Open ethnicity**
Outgoing and sociable, Sarah works as a schoolteacher and has an easy warmth about her. She's been single for a while and struggles to process or identify what she's feeling, particularly when it comes to relationships. She and Ben were friends in high school but drifted apart before reconnecting after college. The hike serves as a chance for them to catch up.

**PRODUCTION DETAILS**
📍 Location: Central Burnaby, BC
📅 Shoot date: October 29, 2026
💰 Compensation: Volunteer, with demo reel material, photos, IMDb credit, and food provided on set
🎭 Open to UBCP/ACTRA members and non-union performers
📩 Submission deadline: October 20, 2026

**HOW TO APPLY**
Please email your headshot, demo reel (if available), and resume to **amistakeshortfilm@gmail.com**. We are also open to first time actors and those who have had no formal training. 

Use the subject line: **[Your Name] – [Character Name] Audition**

Shortlisted applicants will receive **self-tape instructions**. Feel free to share with anyone who might be a good fit. Thanks!

items.text:
Hi! I thought I’d share a little tool I built for myself in case it might be useful to others here.

My daughter does auditions, and I found it surprisingly hard to keep track of everything — submissions, audition requests, callbacks, holds, and shoot dates. Things get scattered across emails and messages, and I wanted one place where I could see everything and keep a history of how things were going.

So I built [CastTrack](https://casttrack.vercel.app/).

It’s a simple casting tracker for parents of young performers. I use it to keep track of where my daughter is with each project and to look back at her audition history and stats.

It’s completely free. I’m a web developer, so it was also a fun project to build for my portfolio, and honestly, I just didn’t want to pay for a tool I needed myself. I’m not planning to monetize it.

My daughter currently auditions mostly through Casting Networks, so that’s what I’ve used it with the most, but it should work with other platforms too.

It’s very much a tool I made to solve my own problem, but maybe someone else will find it useful too. If you try it, I’d love to hear what you think or what could be improved!

[https://casttrack.vercel.app/](https://casttrack.vercel.app/)
items.previewTitle: CastTrack — audition tracking for actors and their parents
items.previewDescription: Auditions come and go, and the details disappear into emails, texts and casting sites. CastTrack keeps the story: every audition adds to a growing record of submissions, callbacks, holds, bookings and everything in between — real data to look back on and compare with what is happening now.

topComments.text: Thank you for building and sharing!

**CASTING CALL: *****SEVEN DEUCE***

**Format:** Short Film / 1970s Neo-Noir Crime Thriller

**Location:** Watkins,CO

**Shoot Dates:** November 14th and 15th

**Pay:** Paid / Non-Union Meals, Footage, and Credit provided

**Logline:** In 1975, a fortified, high-stakes underground poker game spirals out of control when greed, blackmail, undercover surveillance, and paranoia explode into a bloody 3:00 AM standoff.

**OPEN ROLES**
* **SEAT 1: THE NAMELESS VET (Male, 30s)**
* Lean, hardened, haunted. A Vietnam veteran with a dead-eyed thousand-yard stare and lethal military stillness. Speaks in a flat, quiet rasp. Economy of movement; thinks like an ambush survivor.
* **SEAT 2: JIMMY "SPRINTS" (Male, Late 20s–Early 30s)**
* Gaunt, manic, hyperactive, constantly drenched in sweat. A compulsive degenerate gambler in way over his head with loan sharks. Swings wildly between manic euphoria and breathless terror. Big physical and emotional range.
* **SEAT 3: AGENT KANE / "MILLER" (Male, 30s)**
* Sharp, handsome, tailored, cool under pressure. An undercover federal agent wearing a wire, desperately trying to keep his cover intact while counting down the minutes to a tactical raid. Needs an exceptional, subtle poker face.
* **SEAT 4: LEONARD SMOOTHS (Black Male, Late 30s–Early 40s)**
* Tall, imposing, velvet street elegance. A charismatic, stylish pimp with an icy, calculating demeanor. Commands the room with a smooth baritone, but possesses explosive, bare-knuckle violence when pushed.
* **SEAT 5: FRANK "NUMBERS" (Male, 50s–60s)**
* Broad, gravel-voiced mob veteran with horn-rimmed glasses and cold calculation. Treats the high-stakes game like an accounting spreadsheet. The calmest, smartest criminal in the cellar.
* **SEAT 6: RAY "SOLLY" SULLIVAN (Male, 40s–50s)**
* Heavyset, greasy, sweat-soaked, brutal. A deeply corrupt detective who uses his badge as a weapon of extortion and street bullying. Vicious, loud, remorseless, and arrogant.
* **THE DEALER (Female or Male, Late 30s–40s)**
* Sharp, immaculate, surgical. Total mechanical precision with cards and zero visible emotion. Commands absolute authority over dangerous, armed men through icy house rules.
* **WALTER / THE HEAVY (Male, 40s–50s)**
* Imposing, broad, weathered 230+ lb enforcer guarding the cellar door with a shotgun. A man of few words with terrifying physical presence.
**HOW TO SUBMIT**

Please email your **Headshot, Resume, and Reel (or self-tape link)** to:

📧 **tyler.j.stewart14@gmail.com**

**Subject Line:** *7DEUCE - [Role Name] - [Your Full Name]*

*Sides and self-tape instructions will be sent upon review. Feel free to share or tag talent who fit these period roles!*

**SEEKING ACTORS FOR STUDENT PRODUCED TELEVISION SHOW**

**Title:** The Bluffs: Season 13

**Genre:** Dramedy

**Logline: **A punk rocker down on his luck and his funds starts rigging bets using UCCS’s new betting app to pay his mounting pile of bills.

**Roles: **

**HAYDEN: (18-24 YEARS OLD) - MALE, ANY ETHNICITY**

A STRUGGLING PUNK ROCK MUSICIAN. REBELLIOUS AND IMPULSIVE, HE IS TORN BETWEEN BEING FINANCIALLY STABLE AND LIVING AN AUTHENTIC PUNK LIFESTYLE ***THIS ROLE REQUIRES SINGING**

**GRACE: (18-24 YEARS OLD) - FEMALE, ANY ETHNICITY**

HAYDEN’S BEST FRIEND, ROOMMATE, AND BANDMATE. SHE IS QUIETLY CONFIDENT AND HAS A STRONG SENSE OF HER OWN MORALS. VERY PUNK.

**DARBY: (18-24 YEARS OLD) - FEMALE, ANY ETHNICITY**

HAYDEN’S COWORKER WHO IS IN A COMPETING PUNK BAND, ALTHOUGH YOU PROBABLY WOULDN’T KNOW THAT BY LOOKING AT HER. VERY BUSINESS MINDED, SHE IS MORE INTERESTED IN BEING A MUSICIAN FOR THE MONEY AND CLOUT THAN FOR THE ARTISTIC EXPRESSION.

**JP: (30-50 YEARS OLD) - MALE, ANY ETHNICITY**

HAYDEN AND DARBY’S BOSS AND THE BRAIN BEHIND UCCS’ NEW BLUFFBETS APP. A MIDDLE-AGED TECH BRO WHO DESPERATELY TRIES TO BE HIP AND APPEAL TO HIS STUDENT EMPLOYEES.

**Production Company:** UCCS Digital Filmmaking Program

**Production Type: **Student Television Show

**Contact Information:** vsmith@uccs.edu

**Run Time: **Television Show, three 10ish minute episdodes

**Compensation: **Unpaid

**Union Status:** Non-Union

**Audition Information:** October 24th from 2 pm to 7 pm at UCCS, by appointment only: 

https://calendly.com/vsmith-uccs/bluffsseason13audition

Shooting Schedule:

October 31st, 9AM-7PM

November 7th, 9AM-7PM

November 14th, 9AM-7PM

November 21st, 9AM-7PM

December 5th, 9AM-7PM

December 12th, 9AM-7PM

December 19th, 9AM-7PM

***Shoot dates called will depend on the role. Please look at each character to see how frequently we expect you to be called based on the character you audition for**

**Filming Location:** Various, mostly on the UCCS campus, every location with be in Colorado Springs.

**Project Description:** Every year, the UCCS Digital Filmmaking program produces a three episode anthology television show called The Bluffs. Students write, film, and edit the show from start to finish.

Data: 30.10

2. Miłosz (46) – adopcyjny ojciec, przeciętny facet zniszczony życiem, w depresji.

3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)

7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Miejscowość zamieszkania

Hey everyone! We’re a team of LA-based indie filmmakers that are part of a community bringing together people working in movies across Los Angeles. Just good people, great conversations, and real connections. We welcome people at every level of their career.

Our mission is simple: Help each other make movies, connect, and network.

We meet in Boyle Heights every 1st Thursday of the month at 6pm.

Whether you're an actor, filmmaker, writer, producer, director, DOP, or working behind the scenes, we'd love for you to join us!

Entrance is FREE, but RSVP is required as space is limited.

**RSVP here:** https://partiful.com/e/lY9sDO0ZosP3nr2bcNVl?c=Y6ysr1LC

Hope to see some of you there! Feel free to share this with anyone in the LA film and TV community.

Drinks and snacks available for purchase.

🎬 DARSTELLER GESUCHT – REGENSBURG! 🚲

📸 200 € pro Drehtag | Foto- & Videodrehs

Für unsere Fahrradmarke Alphatrail suchen wir sympathische Darsteller (m/w/d) aus Regensburg und Umgebung, die Lust haben, bei professionellen Foto- und Videodrehs mitzuwirken.

✅ 200 € pro Drehtag

✅ 3–5 Drehtage innerhalb eines Monats

✅ Flexible Termine (teilweise wetterabhängig)

✅ Fahrrad & Helm werden gestellt

✅ Erste Kameraerfahrung von Vorteil, aber kein Profi notwendig!

Du solltest sicher Fahrrad fahren, natürlich vor der Kamera wirken und zeitlich flexibel sein.

📩 Interesse? Schick uns einfach eine PN mit deinem Wohnort, 2–3 aktuellen Fotos und deiner zeitlichen Verfügbarkeit.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht! 😊

[Casting Call] Hot Singles Needed for Dating App Promo Video (Paid, SF Bay Area)

Hi everyone! We are casting for a lifestyle promo video and street interview shoot for a dating app in the SF Bay Area. We are currently looking for:

Role: Single Female & Single Male (Cast individually or paired on-site).

Age Range: 28-45 years old.

Ethnicity: White (for the single female) / Open or matching requirements.

Requirements: Athletic/fit build, attractive, high energy, outgoing, native English speakers, and comfortable with dating/flirty street interview style lines.

General Project Details:

Location: San Francisco Bay Area (Outdoor/urban spots like streets, cafes, parks, and restaurants).

Shoot Time: Late October or Early November

Shoot Duration: Approx. 10 hours.

Compensation: Paid (Competitive rate, details shared upon application).

What to Expect:

Casual, authentic lifestyle interactions, street interviews, and fun dating app promotional clips.

How to Apply:
If you are interested, please send a PM or comment below with:

Recent photos / headshots (Full-body & close-up).

A short intro (Name, age, and your location in the Bay Area).

Contact info or social media handles (Instagram/Portfolio).

Looking forward to hearing from you!

Hi everyone!

**Casting:** 3 look alikes for an Investigating Discovery True Crime Docu-Series

Non-Union

Rate: $250/day

Location: Los Angeles, CA

Shoot date: 10/27-10/28

This will be a recreation shoot with no dialogue. Actors will be required to sign an NDA prior to arriving on set.

***To Submit:***

***Email headshot and resume to kwall@altrealitytv.com***

Please do not DM. TIA!

Roles:

[JONATHAN]

Man; 40 to 65 years old;

Casting look alike for an early-mid 50's caucasian male:

Short, clean-cut gray/silver hair Clean-shaven

5'11-6'3

Slender/Lean/Slim-Athletic Build

[DETECTIVE BLOOM]

Man; 30 to 50 years old; White.

Casting Look alike for a 40yo caucasian male:

Short, crew cut-style blonde/gray/light brown hair

Clean-shaven

5'8-6'1

Medium Build- can be athletic or stocky

Please note if you have a police-style uniform.

[LENA]

Woman; 23 to 40 years old; Casting Look alike for an early 30s female, ethnically ambiguous but fair, light, or olive skin (need to match a real person)

Dark, straight, shiny hair shoulder length or a few inches longer

5'7-6'0

Slim build

No visible tattoos or piercings that cannot be covered. Ear piercings are okay.

🎬 CASTING CALL — FEMALE LEAD FOR MUSIC VIDEO
📍 Location: Warsaw, Poland

Dates: 19.10-22.10 (estimate) 

Mystique Studios is casting a female lead, age 26–30, for an upcoming music video production to be filmed in Warsaw, Poland.

We are looking for a woman with:

• East European look

• Natural, innocent features

• Expressive face and comfortable presence in front of the camera

• Acting/modeling experience is welcome, but not essential

• Ability to portray natural emotion, warmth and chemistry on camera

🎥 ABOUT THE PROJECT

The music album has already been released, and we are now producing an official music video intended for YouTube, social media promotion and submission to music video/film festivals.

The shoot will take approximately 1–2 days in Warsaw, Poland.

This is an independent, low-budget production, so please apply with this in mind.

💰 COMPENSATION

This is a paid role, with cash payment depending on the selected cast member, experience and final shooting requirements.

Food, snacks and drinks will be provided during filming.

🎞️ ABOUT US

We are an independent, low-budget production studio focused on films, music and visual storytelling.

Our work includes:

• 2 completed feature films produced for the festival festivals 

• One feature officially selected at 30+ film festivals across Europe and winner of 10+ awards

• 2 released music videos

• 10+ released music albums

• Several new film, music and visual projects currently in development

📩 TO APPLY

Please send:

• Your name and age

• Prefer location - Warsaw 

• 3–5 recent photographs — preferably portrait and full-length

• Links to Instagram or other social media

• Acting/modeling/showreel links, if available

• Brief details of previous experience, if any

WhatsApp: +48 579 162 415

Email: mystiquestudios@yahoo.com

Telegram: @Mystiquestudios

Please write “MUSIC VIDEO CASTING” when contacting us.

Selected applicants may be invited for a short meeting or camera test in Warsaw before final casting.

🎬 Mystique Studios

Independent Film • Music • Visual Storytelling

POSZUKUJEMY STYLISTKI / STYLISTY NA PLAN ZDJĘCIOWY
Do realizacji projektu zdjęciowego poszukujemy doświadczonej stylistki lub stylisty, który kompleksowo zajmie się przygotowaniem garderoby dla 5 osób dorosłych, na podstawie dostarczonego briefu kreatywnego.

SZCZEGÓŁY PRODUKCJI:

• Lokalizacja: Legionowo

• Liczba osób do stylizacji: 5 dorosłych

• Liczba dni zdjęciowych: 4

• Czas pracy: około 10 godzin dziennie

• Terminy: 21 i 22 października (środa i czwartek) oraz 2 dni w kolejnym tygodniu, w terminach uzależnionych od warunków pogodowych.

ZAKRES OBOWIĄZKÓW:

• Kompleksowe przygotowanie i skompletowanie wszystkich stylizacji zgodnie z otrzymanym briefem.

• Samodzielne pozyskanie garderoby, w tym zakup lub wypożyczenie niezbędnych elementów.

• Organizacja, przygotowanie i transport garderoby na plan zdjęciowy.

• Bieżąca opieka nad stylizacjami podczas zdjęć oraz dbanie o ich spójność i ciągłość między ujęciami.

• Koordynacja zwrotów wypożyczonych elementów garderoby po zakończeniu realizacji.

W ZGŁOSZENIU PROSIMY O:

• Portfolio z dotychczasowych realizacji.

• Informację o doświadczeniu przy produkcjach reklamowych, fotograficznych lub filmowych.

• Proponowaną stawkę za dzień zdjęciowy (około 10 godzin).

• Osobną wycenę przygotowania i skompletowania garderoby przed zdjęciami.

• Informację o sposobie rozliczania kosztów zakupu lub wypożyczenia ubrań.

• Potwierdzenie dostępności w podanych terminach.

• Numer telefonu kontaktowego.

ZGŁOSZENIA:

casting.bmbmedia@gmail.com

We are working with the lovely team at Raw Research casting an exciting ITV x PayPal Christmas campaign, and we’re looking for bubbly, fun-loving families (e.g. adult siblings, adults with their parents, couples with children aged 16+, friends and housemates who love Christmas and go the extra mile to make it memorable. We’re particularly keen to hear from adults in their 40s and 50s - though all ages are welcome.

You might be a couple with children aged 16 or older, adult siblings, or grown-up children celebrating with their parents. Whatever your set-up, we’d love to meet people who enjoy a laugh, love ITV and already have plans for this Christmas.

We are looking for people who are London-based or about 90 minutes outside of London.

Do you have a Christmas dilemma we could help with?
Perhaps your adult child has a new partner joining Christmas lunch and you have no idea what to buy them? Maybe you’re determined to surprise your mum or sibling but have run out of ideas? Or perhaps you want to make a friend’s Christmas extra special and need some inspiration!

We’d ideally spend a day filming at your home, having fun planning presents, putting up decorations and calling ITV for help with your Christmas dilemmas. There may even be a quiz about ITV presenters, so a love of ITV and a willingness to be a bit silly are essential!

Filming - Dates TBC but 5th or 6th OR 9th are 10th of November are likely.

Payment:
£350 per person, per filming day.
£2,000 per person if you appear in the final ad campaign.
£500 per household if filming takes place in your home.
Eligibility:
Everyone taking part must be aged 16 or over. Ideally adults in their 40s and 50s!
Participants must be eligible for a PayPal account and have used PayPal or be familiar with it.
Participants must have no adverse credit history, history of debt or financial vulnerability.
Participants must have no current or previous affiliations with competing financial brands.
Interested? Please contact casting@rawresearch.co.uk, telling us who you’d take part with, what makes Christmas special to you and the Christmas dilemma you’d love help with. Please also send a photo of everyone applying, a simple selfie will do!
Thank you

items.text:
🎬 LITTLE STARS: Getting Your Kids Into Acting & Modeling — PART 2! 🌟

How the twins booked their first TV role!
After I submitted the girls' photos, I got an email saying an agent wanted to represent them! She needed a video of the twins playing so the casting director could see their personalities.
Of course, I had a playdate planned that morning, so I think it took me a little while to actually send it over. 

Not long after that, a producer from the show called me! We chatted about the girls and their personalities.

And that was it! They were hired for an episode of a television show! 🥹

It was honestly so much simpler than I ever expected!

A few things I want other parents to know before getting started:

🚩 Legitimate talent agencies do NOT charge upfront fees to represent your child! They make their money through commissions when your child books work. Be very cautious of anyone charging you just to sign with them or promising guaranteed jobs.

📸 You do NOT need expensive professional photos to get started! We submitted regular pictures of the girls. Clear, natural photos showing what your child actually looks like are a great place to start. Don't spend hundreds of dollars on headshots before you even know if this is something you want to pursue.

🚗 Location matters! You'll probably want to live within about three hours of your agency or the filming location. This isn't an official rule, but you need to be able to get to auditions and filming, sometimes on short notice!
Now, before the girls could actually go to work, we needed a few things!

Documents and accounts:

🏦 1. Coogan Accounts
California has a law protecting child performers' earnings. At least 15% of their gross earnings must go into a special blocked trust account that belongs to them. They generally can't access that money until they're 18!
Each girl needed her own Coogan account.

💰 2. Regular Bank Accounts
We also opened regular bank accounts for the girls, separate from their Coogan accounts, for the remainder of their earnings. This was part of how we organized their money.

📄 3. Birth Certificates
You'll need documentation to verify your child's age and identity. We used their birth certificates.

🎬 4. Entertainment Work Permits
Yes, even babies need work permits in California! You apply through the California Labor Commissioner's Office. Regular entertainment work permits are free and must be renewed every six months.

Once we had everything taken care of, we were ready for their very first day on set!

I had absolutely no experience with any of this before we started. I've just been figuring things out as we go, and I want to share what I've learned with other parents who might be interested!

Up next — Part 3: Our first day on set! 🎥💕
Would you ever consider putting your baby or toddler into acting or modeling? I'm curious!

#LittleStars #ChildActors #BabyActors #KidsInActing #ChildModeling #MomLife

sharedPost.text:
A mágica nunca morre. Ela só muda de palco.

Depois de mais de 50 anos criando momentos de surpresa e encantamento, chegou a hora de abrir espaço para novas conversas.

Vem aí o **PodTudoCast — Átila e Rosi**! Um encontro de histórias, experiências e descobertas, com a curiosidade que sempre nos acompanhou dentro e fora dos palcos.

Estamos preparando tudo com muito carinho. Em breve, novidades!

Conta pra gente: quem você gostaria de ver nessa conversa? 👇

#PodTudoCast #ÁtilaERosi #Podcast #Mágica #Novidades

🎬🎬🎬 MEGA ULTRA PILNE! CASTING! 🎬🎬🎬

EPIZODYSTKI I EPIZODYŚCI – ROLKI / TIKTOK / IG

Szanowni Państwo!

Na środę, 21 października 

poszukujemy epizodystek i epizodystów 

do krótkiej formy komercyjnej realizowanej 
na potrzeby kanałów TikTok i Instagram (IG).

🎥 KOGO SZUKAMY?

✅ Kobiet i mężczyzn w wieku 25–50 lat 

✅ Osób polskojęzycznych 

✅ Osób posiadających doświadczenie w pracy przed kamerą

Poszukujemy osób do wielu różnych ról, 
które wcielą się w postaci pracowników 
i klientów marketu.

💰 WYNAGRODZENIE: 500–1000 zł netto

Stawka uzależniona jest od przypisanej postaci i zakresu roli. 
Po zakwalifikowaniu zgłoszonych osób 
do konkretnych postaci skontaktujemy się 
z wybranymi osobami i poinformujemy je 
o proponowanej stawce.

📍 MIEJSCE REALIZACJI: Warszawa

📅 TERMIN: środa, 21 października 

🕘 GODZINY: pierwsza połowa dnia

📩 JAK SIĘ ZGŁOSIĆ?

Osoby zainteresowane i dyspozycyjne prosimy 
o przesłanie zgłoszenia w wiadomości e-mail 

na adres:  📧 abcastingab@gmail.com

📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭

W zgłoszeniu prosimy wpisać:

• Temat: ROLKI  21. 10
• Imię i nazwisko
• Wiek
• Numer telefonu
• Zdjęcie twarzy oraz zdjęcie całej sylwetki
• Informację o doświadczeniu w pracy przed kamerą
• Linki do materiałów wideo, na których można Państwa zobaczyć i usłyszeć

🎬 Poszukujemy osób do wielu postaci — jeśli masz doświadczenie przed kamerą i jesteś dyspozycyjny/a w środę, serdecznie zapraszamy do zgłoszeń!

Do zobaczenia na planie! 🎥🤝

Film Krótkometrażowy Niekomercyjny
Szukamy osób pełnoletnich (18+) do udzielenia krótkiej wypowiedzi głosowej (audio) do autorskiego filmu krótkometrażowego (projekt realizowany z myślą o międzynarodowych festiwalach filmowych).

📅 Kiedy: Sobota, 17 października 2026 r. o godz. 17:00 📍 

Gdzie: Gdańsk (szczegóły podamy w wiadomości prywatnej)

Będzie to wywiad wyłącznie głosowy (bez nagrywania twarzy przed kamerą!).

Na czym polega zadanie? To bardzo krótka, kameralna i bezstresowa rozmowa mikrofonowa. Zadamy trzy krótkie pytania:

„Czego szukamy w galerii handlowej? Po co tu przychodzimy?” (odpowiedź na 1–2 zdania).

„Czego nam brakuje w tej obfitości?” (odpowiedź na 1 zdanie).

„Gdy myśli Pan/Pani o swojej pracy w tym całym technologicznym pędzie, to jakie jedno słowo przychodzi jako pierwsze?” (tylko jedno słowo, np. szybciej, targety, zmęczenie, powiadomienia).

🎁 Co oferujemy w zamian? 

Imię i nazwisko w napisach końcowych filmu. 

Krótką, bezpłatną profesjonalną sesję zdjęciową w ramach podziękowania.

Zainteresowane osoby proszę o kontakt przez e-mail:

1. Poproszę o wysłanie:

Imię i nazwisko, wiek, zdjęcie twarzy. 

oliwia.kapacewicz@gmail.com

Do usłyszenia!

**The Actor's Lab Online / Private Coaching for Actors**

**With 35+ years of experience in the Los Angeles market as an acting coach, mentor, and founder of The Actor’s Lab, I know what it takes to move an acting career forward. Talent is essential, but building a successful career requires more: the right guidance, a strategic approach, and a strong understanding of both the craft and the business of acting.**

**Through my private online coaching, I work one-on-one with actors to sharpen their skills, identify opportunities, overcome career challenges, and develop a focused strategy to take their careers to the next level.**

**My private coaching rate is $125 per hour.**

**I look forward to connecting with you.**

**J.D. Lewis **
**The Actor's Lab **
**(310) 621-3900**
**TheActorsLab@me.com**
**[www.TheActorsLab.com](https://www.TheActorsLab.com)**

ER DU GOD TIL AT LYVE? VI SØGER FRIVILLIGE DELTAGERE TIL EN YOUTUBE-VIDEO I MORGEN! (
Er du god til at lyve, fortælle historier og tage lidt pis på andre? Så søger vi dig!

Vi er Chris & Jacob, og vi mangler 3 personer (18+) til en sjov YouTube-video, vi optager i morgen!

Konceptet:

Vi samler 5 deltagere, som hver især har én vild, sjov eller usædvanlig historie fra deres liv.

Vi skal igennem 5 runder, hvor alle deltagere fortæller deres version af den samme historie. Men kun én fortæller sandheden, mens de andre 4 skal forsøge at lyve sig igennem!

Vores opgave er at afhøre jer og finde ud af, hvem der faktisk har oplevet historien.

Du behøver ikke være skuespiller eller verdensmester i at lyve! I får historiernes overskrifter på forhånd, så I kan forberede jer.

Vi søger bare nogle friske, udadvendte personer med god humor, som har lyst til at være med på kamera!

Praktisk info:

Søndag den 18. oktober kl. 15.00-18.00( konservativt sat, nok kortere)

Amager, København

18+

Det er frivillig og ulønnet deltagelse.

VIL DU VÆRE MED?

Send en SMS til  Mandarina på 31 49 55 65 med:

* Dit navn og alder
* En kort beskrivelse af en vild, sjov, pinlig eller usædvanlig sand historie fra dit liv

Vi mangler kun 3 deltagere, så skriv meget gerne allerede i dag!

CASTING CALL - PALM STONE
Casting four roles for Palm Stone, a nonunion student short film by Tafari Lewis.

A dedicated therapist keeps herself occupied with work and household routines as her clients’ stories begin to challenge her avoidance of her own grief.

SHOOT DETAILS

November 13-15, 2026 • Baltimore, Maryland
Three-day production. Individual actors’ required days will depend on their role. No rehearsals are currently planned.

COMPENSATION

Unpaid. Meals, screen credit, and footage for acting reels will be provided. Travel reimbursement may be discussed depending on distance and available budget.

ROLES
JENNIFER - Lead, woman, playing late thirties. Open ethnicity.

An intelligent and caring therapist who maintains a composed exterior while keeping difficult emotions buried beneath constant activity. Her warmth and dry humor show heavily at home.

Seeking a performer comfortable conveying emotional shifts through quiet reactions and moments of silence.

JACK - Supporting, man, playing late thirties. Open ethnicity.

Jennifer’s husband. Warm, playful, and loves baseball, Jack brings familiar teasing and easy affection to their relationship.

Seeking natural chemistry with Jennifer. The role includes potential hugging and cuddling; no kissing or nudity.

SARAH - Supporting, adult woman; age flexible. Open ethnicity.

A grieving client who finds unexpected comfort in a memory of her partner. Exhausted but capable of warmth and humor, Sarah shares an experience that deeply affects Jennifer. Seeking an honest, understated performance.

DIANE - Voice-only supporting role, adult woman; playing age flexible. Open ethnicity.

Jack’s mother who continues reaching out despite unanswered calls. Her voice carries familiarity and emotional warmth. Recording arrangements will be discussed with selected applicants.

HOW TO APPLY

Submit your headshot, résumé, acting reel, and availability for November 13–15 through the Google Form:

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSds4RfIUGX6G-V-l5qk9cZuDP1EIjcq7vwU8bUENdIzPAuSYw/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=100122457934176448465

Selected applicants will be invited to submit self-tape auditions.

CASTING CALL – PAID LIFESTYLE PHOTOSHOOT
New Jersey | November 16 and/or 17, 2026

Compensation: $250 per person, per shoot day + travel, meals & professional photos!

We are looking for 8 friendly, outgoing individuals to participate in a professional lifestyle photoshoot for our growing meal delivery service!

We want to capture genuine, everyday moments of people enjoying fresh, delicious meals at home with their loved ones.

WHO WE'RE CASTING
Senior Couple – 2 People

Ideally ages 65+

Comfortable portraying a loving couple enjoying meals together

Real couples are encouraged to apply!

Young Adult Couple – 2 People

Ideally ages 25–40

Comfortable portraying a couple enjoying a healthy, convenient lifestyle

Real couples welcome!

Family – 4 People

2 adults, ideally ages 30–45

2 children, ideally ages 4–12

Real families strongly encouraged to apply!

No professional modeling or acting experience required! We are looking for natural smiles, warm personalities, and people who feel comfortable in front of a camera.

SHOOT DETAILS
Location: New Jersey (exact location provided to selected participants)

Dates: Monday, November 16 and/or Tuesday, November 17, 2026

Shoot Type: Professional lifestyle photography for a meal delivery brand

Duration: Up to one full shoot day per participant; final schedule to be confirmed

COMPENSATION & PERKS
$250 CASH per person, per shoot day, paid at the end of the shoot

Round-trip Amtrak transportation provided for selected participants traveling by train

Complimentary meals and refreshments during the shoot

Copies of professionally edited photos for your personal portfolio

Fun, friendly, professional atmosphere!

HOW TO APPLY
Please send:

Your name and age (ages of children if applying as a family)

Your city/state

Which role you're applying for (Senior Couple, Young Couple, or Family)

Two or three recent, clear photos of yourself or your group

Your availability for November 16 and/or 17

Any previous modeling or acting experience (not required)

Apply by emailing or commenting here: Shana@healthyfreshmeals.com 

Selected applicants will receive additional details regarding scheduling, transportation, wardrobe, and the shoot location.

We look forward to meeting you!

Participants will be required to sign a standard photography/model release permitting the use of images in our company's advertising, website, social media, and other marketing materials. A parent or legal guardian must sign for participating minors.

**Updated Casting and Crew Call for Don't Go Yet. Extras, remaining speaking roles, voice actors and crew needed!**

Please see attached previous post for questions on anything not included in this update. 

**Updates**

Dates and Locations – November 7th and 8th in Wheat Ridge. November 14th and 15th in Westminster.

**Crew Call**

Production Assistant 

Camera PA/2nd AC

Reach out to [ctpape19@gmail.com](mailto:ctpape19@gmail.com) with any questions.

**Extras!**

Dates and Location – We need around 10 – 15 extras for the weekend of November 14th and 15th in Westminster.

Description - Ages 25 – 38, any race, any gender for what will be a house party scene along with a crowd reacting to a garage band perform.

Contact – Please email [ctpape19@gmail.com](mailto:ctpape19@gmail.com) if interested!

Compensation – All extras will be fed snacks and meals on the days they are present.

**Supporting Roles Not Cast Yet **

Alec – Supporting – late 20’s to early 30s (any race) – College buddy of Connor’s. Smaller in size. Timid and has trouble sticking up for himself. Is always in the circle but has trouble getting a word in.

Katie – Supporting – Late 20’s to early 30s (any race) – Adam’s on again off again girlfriend. Promiscuous and likes to have a good time when it comes to partying. Her and Adam have a complicated relationship but once Adam puts his famous charm on, she runs back every time.

Compensation – All roles will be fed snacks and meals on the days they are present along with credit on the film.  

**Bit ****Parts**

Female Child – 8 to 11 years old (any race) – Need a child to play a girl scout with one line of dialogue. This part will equate to around 1-2 hours of work.

Mother of girl scout – 35 – 45 years old (same race as child) – Mother of girl scout. This part will equate to around 1-2 hours of work.

**Voiceover Roles**

Matt – 20 – 30 years old (any race) – Connor’s coworker that calls him over the phone regarding a work issue.

Rebecca – 30 -40 years old (any race) – Connor’s manager that joins the phone call regarding work issue.

Comedian on Podcast – 30 – 50 years old (any race) – Comedian is played over a speaker riffing on Huntingtons disease.

**Casting Call - Don't Go Yet **

Logline/Genre - Don’t Go Yet is a short film and passion project of mine. It is a dark dramedy focused on a pair of best friends Adam and Connor. When Adam walks in on a failed suicide attempt by Connor, he persuades him to give twenty-four hours to convince him life is worth living. If he fails, Connor may go through with the suicide with no interruption.

Dates and Locations – Dates have been nailed down but we are aiming for two to three weekends of shooting at the end of October/beginning of November. Locations are close to being locked in with one in Wheat Ridge and the other in Westminster.

Director – Cody Pape

Director of Photography – Alex Sistare

Compensation – The two leads will be paid $150 - $200 a day. Rest of the cast will be unpaid. Snacks and meals will be provided on all shoot days. You’ll also receive credit for the film.

Union Status – Non-union

Audition information - If interested please email [ctpape19@gmail.com](mailto:ctpape19@gmail.com) with the subject line “Don’t Go Yet – Your Name” with head shots, reels and any other applicable material and I will send sides in response. Once we have dates locked, we plan to hold in-person auditions for the two leads and most of the supporting cast.

Project Notes –** **Please note that this project contains heavy drug use and acts of suicide and self-harm.

**Characters**

Connor – Lead – late 20’s to early 30s male (any race) – A scrawny, handsome but unkept male that has lost all excitement about life. A small number of tattoos is preferred but not a requirement. He was once a very loving, outgoing person loved by many before everyone around him started to grow up. He refuses to make changes in his life due to the effort required to make them. Contact with close friends has depleted and he hasn’t been on a date in years. The only consistent thing in his life that brings him genuine joy is his best friend, Adam. He’s not miserable but he’s not happy. He’s done with the monotony of existing.

Preferred skills:
* Experience with instruments, specifically drums and/or guitar.
* Stunt work is required for this role. Suicide attempt by hanging, plastic bag over the head and prat falls are included in this role.
* Knowledge of hardcore and heavier music.

Adam – Lead – late 20’s to early 30s male (any race) - Adam is an average height; muscular man covered in tattoos with a smile they would use in a toothpaste advertisement. It's not mentioned that he is ex-military, but his appearance would suggest he served. He has a handful of extremely close relationships with men in his life but dates a new woman every month. He is the epitome of toxic masculinity and has no idea how to express himself. All feelings and emotions are under lock and key except when it comes to Connor who has access at times.

Preferred skills:
* Experience with instruments, specifically drums and/or guitar.
* Stunt work is required for this role. Suicide attempt by hanging.
* Knowledge of hardcore and heavier music.

Alec – Supporting – late 20’s to early 30s male (any race) – College buddy of Connor’s. Smaller in size. Timid and has trouble sticking up for himself. Is always in the circle but has trouble getting a word in.

Amanda – Supporting – late 20’s to early 30s female (any race) – A mutual friend of Adam and Connor’s. What once was an extremely important platonic friendship for Connor who could come to Amanda with any problem and get the support needed has become something distant to the point that Amanda has given up on the friendship. She is energetic, bubbly and can be a little bit of a steamroller in conversation. She finds it easy to give relationship advice but can’t figure out why she hasn’t found Mr. Right yet.

Gabe – Supporting - late 20’s to early 30s male or female (any race) – Connor and Adam’s old guitar player in a band that was taking off before Connor decided to self-sabotage the success. Gabe doesn’t hold any resentment. He lives in the moment at all times and couldn’t bother himself with what happened yesterday or the events of tomorrow.

Preferred skills:
* Experience with instruments, specifically drums and/or guitar.
* Knowledge of hardcore and heavier music.

Greg – Supporting – late 20’s to early 30s male (any race) – A high school friend of Connor and Adam’s. The starting quarterback that had all eyes on him on and off the field has had trouble accepting that time of his life is no longer around. He doesn’t have a lot going on upstairs. He assumed his body would take him places until laziness and beer took that from him. He is large and in charge in conversation and physical appearance. He picks on those smaller than him, projecting his own pain but is also quite oblivious to anyone’s feelings but his own.

Hailey – Supporting – late 20’s to early 30s female (any race) – Connor’s ex-girlfriend. To Connor, Hailey is the one that got away. They’re not together for many reasons but when they look at each other, there is an unspoken agreement that they will try again at some point. Hailey is the struggling artist that has it all figured out on the outside but due to past trauma can’t seem to give herself over to anyone once it becomes serious. Indie, alternative, mildly goth aesthetic. Piercings and tattoos are encouraged.

Tim – Supporting – late 20’s to early 30s male (any race) – Amanda’s new boyfriend that give’s Connor some perspective on life. Tim is a counterweight to Amanda’s energy and appears to be the answer to her prayers. You can tell they’re madly in love by the synchronicity of their laughter.

Vinny – Supporting - late 20’s to early 30s male (any race) – Singer or Guitar player of Adam and Connor’s old band. He was also Connor’s closest friend aside from Adam. He’s gone on with the band’s name with new members and is seeing the success that Connor always dreamed of. Both Connor and Vinny hold resentment towards each other. Vinny see’s Connor as wasted potential while Connor sees him as a sellout.

Preferred skills
* Experience with instruments, specifically drums and/or guitar.
* Knowledge of hardcore and heavier music.

Look forward to hearing from you!

Calling all filmmakers! The 2027 edition has just launched - and we want to see YOUR short films!

Now in their 5th year, the free-to-enter Awards are bigger than ever. This year, we introduced a brand new Immersive category, presented by Meta, celebrating how immersive formats expand the way we experience storytelling.

The filmmakers behind 34 shortlisted films will be flown to Los Angeles to attend a four-day industry program on the Sony Pictures Studios lot to help elevate their careers. You will learn from Sony Pictures executives through workshops, masterclasses, panel discussions, screenings, demos, tours and Q&As.

The week ends with a bang at a red carpet Awards ceremony, a perfect opportunity to network with fellow filmmakers and industry experts.

The six categories are:
• Fiction
• Non-Fiction
• Animation
🆕 Immersive
• Student
• Future Format

Why enter? 

✈️ Be flown to Los Angeles for an exclusive industry program (flights + accommodation included)
✍️ Gain unparalleled access to the inner workings of the industry through sessions and masterclasses led by Sony Pictures executives
🎩 Celebrate your success and network with fellow creatives at the Awards night on the Sony Pictures Studios lot
🎥 Winners receive a range of prizes depending on their category, including Sony camera equipment, a Meta VR device, and cash prizes. 

🆕Also new this year: The Snapdragon Shorts Award. Five filmmakers, selected from the 2027 shortlist, will be given an array of Snapdragon powered devices and equipment including a smartphone and laptop to create an original short film. The winner receives an all-expenses-paid trip to Hawaii for an official announcement and film premiere at the Snapdragon Summit and exposure to millions through the Snapdragon Insiders community.

Take the next exciting step in your filmmaking career, widen your professional network and gain insight from people who have shaped the industry today.

🔗 Enter your short film for free now! Link in bio.

@sonypictures @metaquest

items.text:
**[ZLECENIE PŁATNE, CYKLICZNE]**

**WARSZAWA — CASTING DO SPEKTAKLU KOMEDIOWEGO**

Do nowego, niezależnego spektaklu komediowego z elementami interakcji z publicznością (dorosłą) szukamy **zawodowego aktora i zawodowej aktorki** do dwóch głównych ról.

**Szukamy wyłącznie osób mieszkających w Warszawie**, dostępnych na miejscu do prób i współpracy.

Interesuje nas humor sytuacyjny, precyzja i umiejętność słuchania partnera. Szukamy osób, które potrafią być zabawne, traktując swoją postać i jej problemy zupełnie serio.

**WIKTOR** — pewny siebie entuzjasta technologii i samozwańczy wizjoner. Modny, zadbany, bussiness casual w wieku 30-40 lat. Chce uchodzić za człowieka, który wszystko rozumie pierwszy. Im mniej kontroluje sytuację, tym bardziej przekonująco ją wyjaśnia. Lekko zmanieryzowany.

**ADA** — aspirująca ekspertka technologiczna, świeżo po studiach. Ambitna, ciekawa świata, bardzo chce sprostać zadaniu. Wiedzę dopiero zdobywa, a brak pewności próbuje przykrywać fachowym językiem.

Szukamy osób z **zawodowym doświadczeniem scenicznym**, szczególnie z wyczuciem komedii i swobodą w kontakcie z publicznością. Zależy nam na gotowości do współtworzenia roli podczas prób.

Planujemy długoterminową współpracę. Terminy spektakli będą nieregularne, zależne od zamówień. Praca zawsze w tygodniu, weekendy wolne.

**Wynagrodzenie do ustalenia na castingu, ale minimum 1000 zł/ spektakl. **Spektakl trwa około 2 godzin: godzinę stanowią sceny oparte na scenariuszu, a pozostałą część — prowadzone w rolach interakcje i zabawy z publicznością, z przestrzenią na improwizację. **Materiał tekstowy do przygotowania obejmuje więc około godziny przedstawienia.**

**ZGŁOSZENIA W KOMENTARZACH POD POSTEM LUB MAILOWO NA: **spolkazograniczonao@gmail.com

Prosimy podać:
* Rolę, do której się zgłaszasz: **Wiktor / Ada**.
* **Link do wideo pokazującego Twoją grę aktorską.**
* Link do portfolio lub krótkiego CV aktorskiego. Jeśli nie posiadasz, nagraj nam krótki selftape i opowiedz o sobie i swoim doświadczeniu aktorskim.

**Nagranie jest najważniejszym elementem zgłoszenia. Zgłoszeń bez linku do wideo pokazującego grę aktorską nie będziemy rozpatrywać.**

Może to być istniejąca scena, fragment spektaklu lub showreel — nie wymagamy przygotowania nowego nagrania. Najlepiej wskaż 1–2 minuty, które mamy obejrzeć. Sprawdź, czy link działa i materiał jest dostępny bez proszenia o uprawnienia.

**Termin zgłoszeń: wtorek, 20.10.2026, do godz. 23:59.**

**Casting stacjonarny dla wybranych osób: czwartek, 22.10.2026, Warszawa.**

Z wybranymi osobami skontaktujemy się prywatnie. Prześlemy fragment scenariusza, szczegółowe warunki współpracy oraz adres i indywidualną godzinę spotkania.

items.text:
Mezinárodní filmový festival BRNO16 se řadí mezi nejdéle fungující filmové festivaly v České republice. Od svého založení v roce 1960 se koná nepřetržitě a zároveň patří k nejstarším přehlídkám krátkometrážní tvorby na světě. Představuje široké spektrum krátkých filmů, od hraných a animovaných až po experimentální snímky, a to jak od studentů, tak od profesionálních i neprofesionálních tvůrců. Vedle prestižní filmové soutěže nabízí také bohatý doprovodný program zahrnující výstavy, diskuse a workshopy. Festival každoročně hostí řadu českých i zahraničních osobností, které návštěvníkům umožňují nahlédnout do zákulisí své tvorby a diskutovat o filmech i zkušenostech z filmového prostředí.
___
Plánujete dorazit? 🎬
___

Mezinárodní filmový festival BRNO16 se řadí mezi nejdéle fungující filmové festivaly v České republice. Od svého založení v roce 1960 se koná nepřetržitě a zároveň patří k nejstarším přehlídkám krátkometrážní tvorby na světě. Představuje široké spektrum krátkých filmů, od hraných a animovaných až po experimentální snímky, a to jak od studentů, tak od profesionálních i neprofesionálních tvůrců. Vedle prestižní filmové soutěže nabízí také bohatý doprovodný program zahrnující výstavy, diskuse a workshopy. Festival každoročně hostí řadu českých i zahraničních osobností, které návštěvníkům umožňují nahlédnout do zákulisí své tvorby a diskutovat o filmech i zkušenostech z filmového prostředí.
___
Plánujete dorazit? 🎬
___
#kinoboxcz #kinobox #pozvánka #festival #brno16

7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Miejscowość zamieszkania 

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu/noclegu

Szukamy osób do badania dotyczącego systemów POS w gastronomii 🍽️
Prowadzimy badanie na temat systemów POS i rozwiązań kasowych wykorzystywanych w lokalach gastronomicznych i szukamy osób, które mają praktyczne doświadczenie z ich wyborem lub codziennym użytkowaniem.

👤 Kogo szukamy?

właścicieli lokali gastronomicznych,

managerów,

osób odpowiedzialnych za wybór systemu POS / kasy,

osób, które mają realną wiedzę na temat użytkowanego w lokalu rozwiązania.

💬 Na czym polega badanie?

Zapraszamy na około 60-minutową rozmowę online, podczas której porozmawiamy o doświadczeniach związanych z systemem POS, jego wyborem, użytkowaniem oraz potrzebami lokalu.

Na początku zadamy kilka krótkich pytań, żeby sprawdzić, czy profil uczestnika i lokalu pasuje do założeń badania.

Jeśli prowadzisz lokal gastronomiczny lub odpowiadasz w nim za system POS i chciał(a)byś podzielić się swoim doświadczeniem, napisz do mnie w wiadomości prywatnej.

Dziękuję! 🙌

Masaż Lomi Lomi – nie musisz czekać na urlop, żeby naprawdę odpocząć

Czasem myślimy o odpoczynku jak o czymś dużym: tygodniu na plaży, wyjeździe w góry, kilku dniach bez telefonu. Takie chwile są piękne i potrzebne, ale nie zawsze możemy sobie na nie pozwolić wtedy, kiedy najbardziej ich potrzebujemy. I wtedy masaż, podczas którego możesz odłożyć codzienność na bok, przychodzi Ci z pomocą.

Masaż Lomi Lomi wywodzi się z tradycji hawajskiej i wyróżnia się płynnymi ruchami, często wykonywanymi przedramionami. Dotyk jest szeroki i otulający, a ruchy płynnie przechodzą jedne w drugie. Dzięki temu masaż może przypominać spokojny rytm fal – bez gwałtownych zmian, bez pośpiechu, bez konieczności kontrolowania każdego kolejnego momentu.

To doświadczenie, w którym możesz pozwolić sobie nie zastanawiać się, co będzie za pięć minut. Nie prowadzić rozmowy, nie szukać rozwiązań ani nie układać w głowie planu na jutro. Możesz skupić się na tym, co dzieje się tu i teraz: na cieple, rytmie dotyku, kontakcie z własnym ciałem i oddechu, który z czasem być może stanie się spokojniejszy.

Nie musisz przychodzić na masaż z konkretnym problemem. Nie musisz nawet wiedzieć, czego dokładnie potrzebujesz. Czasami wystarczy poczucie, że od dłuższego czasu jesteś dla wszystkich, tylko nie dla siebie.

Jeśli czujesz, że potrzebujesz przerwy, zapraszamy Cię do Gabinetu Czas Relaksu na masaż Lomi Lomi. Stworzymy Ci przestrzeń, w której możesz zwolnić, odetchnąć i na chwilę odsunąć od siebie codzienne obowiązki.

CZAS RELAKSU 

Gabinet Masażu i Terapii Holistycznych

ul. Kosynierów 80d/2, 84-230 Rumia

Godziny otwarcia 10 – 21 od poniedziałku do soboty. 

Rezerwacja wizyt: +48 607 107 702; +48 609 107 773,

🍂✨ **JESIENNY WERNISAŻ TALENTÓW — TU KAŻDA PASJA MOŻE ZOSTAĆ ZAUWAŻONA!** 🎨🎶

Jesień potrafi zmieniać zwykłe dni w coś wyjątkowego — kolorem, nastrojem i inspiracją. Dlatego właśnie teraz zapraszamy do udziału w **II Międzynarodowym Konkursie Sztuki „JESIENNY WERNISAŻ TALENTÓW”**. To propozycja dla wszystkich, którzy chcą pokazać swoją pracę, występ lub projekt i zrobić kolejny krok w swoim artystycznym rozwoju. 🌟

📅 **Przyjmowanie zgłoszeń: 17.10–01.11.2026**

💻 **Uczestnictwo zdalne** — możesz wziąć udział bez względu na miejsce zamieszkania.

W konkursie czekają na uczestników:

🌟 **bez ograniczeń wiekowych**;  
🎭 **wszystkie nominacje i gatunki**;  
📜 **dyplomy i listy podziękowania**;

Recruitment: Male Dancers for International Dance Productions in Singapore
We are seeking talented male dancers to join our team in Singapore to create world-class stage productions with an international vision!

Job Responsibilities

- Participate in rehearsals and live performances for dance productions, special shows, and various stage projects.

- Work closely with choreographers and directors to execute choreography and maintain high performance standards.

- Collaborate effectively with the team while maintaining professionalism, discipline, and performance readiness.

- Participate in promotional activities, technical rehearsals, and other project-related activities when required.

Requirements

Dance Skills

- Proficient in Chinese classical/traditional dance, contemporary dance, or other dance styles.

- Versatile dancers with multiple dance backgrounds are welcome. Specific requirements can be discussed.

Physical Requirements

Minimum height: 178 cm (barefoot).

Weight: 75–85 kg.

Moderate body fat percentage.

S-tier muscular definition and physique.

Appearance & Stage Presence

S-tier physical appearance and overall presentation.

Handsome facial features and outstanding charisma.

Strong stage presence, confidence, and natural performance ability.

Professional Experience

- Previous professional stage performance experience.

- Excellent stage control, expressiveness, and camera presence.

- Ability to engage and captivate live audiences.

- Professional Attitude

- Friendly, approachable, and communicative.

- Passionate about performing arts.

- Strong work ethic, discipline, and teamwork.

🎤❤️ Musik verbindet – Menschen, Herzen und Traditionen! ❤️🎶

Beim wunderschönen Gesangswettbewerb „Lichtkegel“ durften wir Katinka kennenlernen. ✨ Sie hat uns erzählt, wie ihre musikalische Reise begann und was sie ganz besonders macht: das Jodeln! 🏔️🎵

In einer Zeit, in der Volksmusik leider nicht mehr überall im Mittelpunkt steht, finden wir es umso schöner, dass es Menschen wie Katinka gibt, die diese besondere musikalische Tradition mit so viel Leidenschaft und Herz weiterleben. ❤️🎶

Vielen Dank, liebe Katinka, für diesen wunderbaren Einblick in deine musikalische Welt! 🥰

👉 Noch viel mehr gibt es auf unserem JSW Fernsehen YouTube-Kanal! Dort findet ihr das komplette Interview mit Katinka sowie unseren gesamten Beitrag mit vielen weiteren wunderbaren Sängerinnen und Sängern. Freut euch auf tolle Begegnungen, bewegende Geschichten und jede Menge Musik! 🎤🎼

📺 JSW Fernsehen
📻 Radio Heimat – Musik mit Herz! ❤️

https://youtu.be/_kUUv1bjymI?is=ZBt0vCGU6rVx-Sv7

✨ Wir verbinden Musik, Unterhaltung und Menschen – mit Herz, Leidenschaft und ganz viel Gefühl! ✨

Szukamy osób o etnicznej urodzie w wieku 5-17 lat do odgrywania scenek na nagrania/badania w Warszawie (Białołęka) w terminie 19.10-23.10.

1. Czas nagrania - 1 godzina. Przedział godzinowy od 8:00 do 16:00. Dokładny termin i godziny do uzgodnienia.

2. Zależy nam na dużej różnorodności etnicznej dzieci.

3. Wynagrodzenie za udział dziecka: 300 zł netto (płatne w ciągu 1 dnia po zleceniu — BLIK/konto bankowe).

W razie zainteresowania prosimy o wysłanie zgłoszenia dziecka, podając następujące informację:

1. Imię i nazwisko

2. Rok urodzenia

3. Miasto zamieszkania

4. Telefon kontaktowy do rodzica

5. Adres e-mail do rodzica

6. Wzrost

7. Prosimy o podanie dat i przedział godziny dyspozycyjności?

8. Minimum jedno zdjęcie

Kontakt: rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl

W temacie wiadomości prosimy napisać: Nagrania-Scenki

Wysłanie zgłoszenie jest jednoznaczne z wyrażeniem zgody na przetwarzanie danych osobowych w celu udziału w projekcie zgodnie z Rozporządzeniem Parlamentu Europejskiego i Rady (UE) 2016/679 z dnia 27 kwietnia 2016 r. w sprawie ochrony osób fizycznych w związku z przetwarzaniem danych osobowych i w sprawie swobodnego przepływu takich danych oraz uchylenia dyrektywy 95/46/WE (ogólne rozporządzenie o ochronie danych). Administratorem Twoich danych osobowych pozyskanych w procesie rekrutacyjnym jest Agencja Artystyczna INFERNAL. Podanie danych jest dobrowolne, w każdej chwili przysługuje Ci prawo do wglądu do danych, ich poprawiania lub usunięcia. Kontakt do administratora rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl.

VANCOUVER CASTING CALL — TWO FEMALE ROLES
We’re seeking two performers who can portray teenage girls, ages 13–19, for an independent short film exploring social issues affecting women. Adults who can convincingly play teens are welcome to apply.

Role 1: Open to all ethnicities

Role 2: Seeking an Indigenous performer

We’re looking for a natural presence and emotional depth. No acting experience or demo reel is required. Please send a short, makeup-free video introducing yourself.

Location: Vancouver

Filming: Two days in early November

Compensation: Unpaid portfolio project. Meals provided on both days.

The film is led by a female director, with a crew of Vancouver Film School graduates currently working in the industry. The director’s previous short received selections and awards across four film festivals in London and the United States. We plan to submit this film to more than 50 festivals.

Please send your introduction video and availability to hiayj23@gmail.com.

Thank you for your interest. Sharing this casting call is appreciated.

items.text:
Call for Participants: Staged Reading Theatre Workshop

Are you an aspiring or experienced actor with lived experience of addiction?

“Saving the Timothy” — A Modern Retelling of “A Christmas Carol”

The Recovered Arts Collective is seeking actors for an upcoming staged reading of Saving the Timothy, a new dramatic comedy written and directed by John-David Hutchison.

We also require Stage Manager, Assistant Director, Lighting & Sound Technicians

About the Project
We are bringing together a community of people with lived experience of addiction to participate in developing this new play. This project will culminate in a staged reading—a live performance where actors read the script with minimal sets, props, or costumes. Performers focus on character development, vocal expression, and text interpretation in a supportive, low-pressure environment.

Logline
A washed-up, addiction-ravaged Hollywood director returns to his small-town Canadian theatre roots to stage A Christmas Carol, where the specter of his late partner forces him through a dark, hallucinatory journey across his past, present, and future toward 12-step redemption and sobriety.

Who Can Join & What to Expect
Inclusive Community: Everyone is welcome! Whether you are a seasoned creative or have never stepped foot on a stage before, no previous experience is required—just a willingness to share your story and connect.

Supportive Environment: A peer-led space focused on safety, creative expression, personal growth, and building lasting relationships.

Collaborative Process: Work together to bring personal and community stories to life, culminating in a public staged reading performance.

Key Dates & Location
Audition / Table Read: Sunday, November 1, 2026, 2:00 PM – 6:00 PM
Rehearsals: Sundays (November 8, 15, 22, 29), 2:00 PM – 6:00 PM
Performance: Sunday, December 6, 2026 (Time TBD)
Location: The Vancouver Recovery Club, 2775 Sophia St, Vancouver, BC

How to Apply / Audition Instructions

To be considered, please fill out the Google Form https://forms.gle/ZDC2c8M5xwWVjiPn7 
or submit an introduction letter, headshot/selfie & resume/experience to hello@therecoveredartscollective.org  by October 30, 2026 

Character Breakdown
Eban Miser: A once-prominent Broadway and Hollywood director who, after facing bankruptcy, career failure, and struggles with alcoholism and drug addiction, returns to his hometown to direct a local production of A Christmas Carol and undergoes a redemptive journey toward sobriety.

Jake O'Connor/The Ghost of Christmas Future: Eban's late business partner and co-founder of the Timothy Findley Theatre, who dies broke and unaccomplished, but happy and whose reanimated corpse warns Eban to change his destructive path.

Bob Cratchit: Eban's loyal and hardworking stage manager at the theatre, who later becomes an equal partner and helps care for Timothia.

Fred: Eban's cheerful and persistent nephew who repeatedly invites him to holiday gatherings and tries to show him goodwill.

Clara: Fred's wife and member of the theatre troupe

Bill (The Ghost of Christmas Past): A calm, guiding figure who leads Eban through his spectral journey 

Fan: Eban's late sister.

Mr. Fezziwig: Eban's enthusiastic high school gym teacher who features in his past memory of a school dance.

Patricia: Eban's former fiancée who broke off their relationship because he abandoned their shared values for the pursuit of wealth.

Belle: Eban's former partner who left him because of his unaddressed alcoholism.

Emily: Bob Cratchit's sharp-tongued wife who helps run the household and cares for Timothia.

Timothia: Jake’s sullen 15-year-old orphaned daughter who lives with Bob and Emily.

Jack: The abusive stepfather from Eban's childhood.

Craig: Belle's husband.

Nancy, Topper, and Friends: Members of the theatre troupe
Roastmaster and 3 Roast Comics: Roasters of Eban (These four roles are specifically for comedians who will assist in the writing of the roast dialogue.)

This is a volunteer opportunity and you must be committed to the rehearsal schedule.

How to Apply / Audition Instructions

To be considered, please fill out the Google Form https://forms.gle/ZDC2c8M5xwWVjiPn7 
or submit an introduction letter, headshot/selfie & resume/experience to hello@therecoveredartscollective.org  by October 30, 2026 

Casting selection will be through the table read.

Questions? Reach out to hello@therecoveredartscollective.org with the subject line "Staged Reading Inquiry."

items.text:
STAFFING BOSTON CELTICS & BRUINS!!
Branded Promo Talent, a leading experiential marketing agency, is seeking reliable, enthusiastic, and professional Brand Ambassadors to represent TD Bank at Boston Celtics and Boston Bruins home games at TD Garden in Boston, MA!

Event 1: Celtics

Friday, October 23, 2026

3:00 PM – 9:00 PM (TBC)

Event 2: Bruins

Saturday, October 24, 2026

3:00 PM – 9:00 PM (TBC)

Location:

TD Garden

100 Legends Way

Boston, MA 02114

Compensation:

Team Lead — $35 per hour

Brand Ambassadors — $30 per hour

— 1099, paid weekly —

Parking:

Parking reimbursed with receipt.

Attire:

Branded t-shirts will be provided. Wear black pants (no leggings, sweatpants, or ripped/torn jeans) with clean, comfortable white sneakers. Long-sleeved black or white layers may be worn underneath the branded shirt, and black jackets are permitted as needed for colder weather.

Event Details: 

TD Bank is bringing game-day excitement to TD Garden for back-to-back home games featuring the Boston Celtics on Friday and the Boston Bruins on Saturday! Brand Ambassadors will be stationed throughout the exterior plaza and indoor concourse areas, engaging with fans, creating personalized player trading cards, and assisting with interactive games.

Team Lead Duties: 

• Must have experience leading large teams. 

• Oversee staff and coordinate team assignments. 

• Ensure smooth event execution and client communication. 

• Capture event photos and submit recaps.

Staff Duties:

• Assist with event prep, execution, and breakdown to ensure smooth operations.

• Engage with fans, communicate key brand messaging, and guide guests through the activation. 

• Maintain a fun, welcoming, and energetic atmosphere to create memorable fan experiences. 

• Support event activities, manage guest flow, and assist with giveaways.

Staff Expectations: 

We want high-energy, outgoing, and engaging Brand Ambassadors who know how to hype a crowd and create great vibes. You must be punctual, professional, and ready to bring it from start to finish!

Application Process:

To be considered, email chrissy@brandedpromotalent.com with the following:

• Availability

• Resume

• Headshot

• Relevant experience

• A brief description of why you're an excellent fit for this role.

Please use "TD Garden - Celtics & Bruins" as the subject of your email.

Note: Only applicants who follow all instructions will be considered. Our team will review qualifications via email and schedule a call with eligible candidates.

Are you a Descendant of the  Mayflower passengers?

Jodi Purdy Casting Director sharing:

Casting Call 

Archive House Productions is filming a docuseries exploring the legacy of the pilgrims' and their role in shaping America's cultural heritage. 

We're looking for descendants of passengers who sailed on the Mayflower to join us for a filmed dinner the week before or after Thanksgiving in one of three locations: Providence, RI; Boston, MA; and Albany, NY. 

You will receive a stipend for your time. 

Please register your interest by filling in this form. If you are casted, the production will be in touch. 

Please share that you heard of this from Jodi Purdy!

topComments.text: If this company uses AI slop for their posters, how badly are they going to treat their other artists?

Please don't use #AIslop for casting calls. 🙁
AI is MURDERING HUMAN BEINGS. If that's not reason enough to stop using it, I don't know what is. 💔
#AIslop should not be used by Casting professionals and other industry pros, to officially communicate with actors, either as casting calls, promo posts, advertisements or other messages.
The simple facts that AI was founded on the STOLEN work of actors and other artists; and has become such a volatile disruptor of our entire industry, causing the loss of jobs, the cheapening of our art form, not to mention the very real destruction of our environment, which MOST artists care deeply about...
That alone should be enough for the pros to acknowledge and be sensitive to the fact that using the technology is disrespectful to the actors they work with.
